item.title: Agentic AI as a Research Tool
item.description: This scratchpad explores how agentic AI can be used as a practical research tool. It focuses on understanding how AI agents can support literature review, data analysis, writing, coding, workflow automation, and knowledge organization.

item.title: Local LLMs
item.description: This scratchpad collects my notes on running and working with local large language models. It is meant to better understand model deployment, inference tools, hardware requirements, quantization, fine-tuning, evaluation, and practical workflows for using LLMs outside cloud-based platforms.

item.title: Introduction to LLM
item.description: This scratchpad collects the LLM introduction series, an eight-part walkthrough from transformer basics to responsible deployment. Many examples use evacuation and transportation planning as a running case, but the concepts apply broadly.
